name: dumbbell seated reverse grip biceps curl
description: A seated curl with an overhand grip that hits the forearms and brachialis hard along with the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down, arms hanging at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and curl the weights up.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical and your wrists stay straight.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Use a lighter weight than a normal curl.
